Package com.j3d.engine.interact.cmd.commands.transform.mouse

Class TransformMouseOwner

java.lang.Object
java.awt.event.MouseAdapter
com.j3d.engine.interact.input.mouse.MouseOwner
com.j3d.engine.interact.input.mouse.SnapMouseOwner
com.j3d.engine.interact.cmd.commands.transform.mouse.TransformMouseOwner
All Implemented Interfaces:
EventEmitterInterface, MouseListener, MouseMotionListener, MouseWheelListener, EventListener
Direct Known Subclasses:
RotateMouseOwner, ScaleMouseOwner, TranslateMouseOwner
public class TransformMouseOwner extends SnapMouseOwner
A specialized MouseOwner that manages user interaction with a set of 3D transformation handles.

Responsible for detecting when a user clicks on a Handle, selecting an axis for manipulation. Subclasses, such as TranslateMouseOwner or ScaleMouseOwner, extend this class for either no additional stuff or extra drawing using the handles.

Lehlogonolo Poole

    • mousePressed

      public void mousePressed(MouseEvent e)
      Handles the mouse pressed event to detect handle selection. It iterates through all managed handles and checks if the click was within the bounds of any of them. If a handle is clicked, it is marked as selected.
